mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.status AS orderStatus, p.total_picking AS totalPicking, p.completed_picking AS completedPicking, ob.outbound_status AS outboundStatus, d.delivery_company AS deliveryCompany, d.tracking_code AS trackingCode FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS total_picking, SUM(CASE WHEN picking_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_picking FROM picking WHERE order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY order_id) p ON p.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN delivery d ON d.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN outbound ob ON ob.delivery_id = d.id WHERE o.id = #{orderId}
